_meta.description: Pinned inference-runtime binaries for on-device model execution. Separate from local-models/v1/catalog.json (model weights / GGUF pointers). Consumers resolve the row for their platform key (e.g. darwin-arm64) and download the artifact URL — no GitHub release API guessing.

catalog_governance.canonical_source: This file. Published to https://github.com/Eriador-Admin/eriador-model-catalog at local-runtimes/v1/runtime-catalog.json.
catalog_governance.consumer_contract: Desktop (Anfalas) fetches over HTTPS, validates against local-runtimes/v1/schema.json, caches to disk, and falls back to a bundled copy when remote is unreachable.
catalog_governance.weights_track: Model GGUF weights remain in local-models/v1/catalog.json (gguf.repo_id + gguf.filename → Hugging Face).
catalog_governance.runtime_track: This file — llama-server and future on-device engines.
catalog_governance.future_cloud_track: Planned: deployment_recipes for vLLM/SGLang/custom_endpoint bootstrap (orthogonal to laptop binaries; same Eriador repo, separate path).

runtimes.description: Default on-device inference engine for Belfalas Desktop. Spawned on loopback after model download.
